company.name: Aimon Labs
company.shortDescription: AIMon enables reliable adoption of Enterprise Generative AI.
company.description:
AIMon empowers Fortune 200 enterprises to build deterministic and dependable Generative AI applications. The platform continuously monitors your apps to detect critical issues such as hallucinations, instruction deviation, and poor RAG retrieval, while also generating high-quality, targeted datasets that accelerate model improvement.

With benchmark-leading accuracy, AIMon closes the loop between detection and optimization to help you deliver AI that performs exactly as intended.

productsAndServices.description: A multi-model system for detecting hallucinations in large language models, supporting offline and online evaluation with a hosted API for batch and real-time monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Aimon Rely

productsAndServices.description: A domain-adaptable model for evaluating and improving retrieval relevance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, available via a low-latency API for re-ranking and evaluation.
productsAndServices.name: RRE-1 (Retrieval Relevance Evaluator and Re-ranking Model)

productsAndServices.description: Detectors that assess the completeness and conciseness of LLM-generated text outputs to ensure comprehensive and succinct responses.
productsAndServices.name: Completeness and Conciseness Detectors
